Name: Btrack
Notes: Bayesian belief propagation; handles division/death; napari plugin available

Name: CellProfiler
Notes: Pipeline-based; LAP tracking module; good for fluorescence; batch processing

Name: DeepLabCut
Notes: Keypoint tracking; originally for animals; 2D + 3D; needs labeled data

Name: Icy
Notes: Java; plugin ecosystem; spot detector + track manager; less maintained now

Name: idtracker.ai
Notes: idtracker.ai is a Python package available on PyPI, fully compatible with Windows, Linux, and macOS.

Name: Imaris
Notes: Gold standard for fluorescent cell tracking; 2D also supported; expensive

Name: Laptrack
Notes: LAP-based; modular cost functions; gap closing; integrates with napari

Name: Manual Tracker
Notes: Fiji plugin; click-to-track; useful for ground truth and validation

Name: napari-btrack
Notes: Btrack GUI in napari; good for dense dividing cells

Name: napari-trackpy
Notes: Trackpy wrapped in napari; visual inspection + parameter tuning

Name: OpenCV
Notes: Background subtraction + contour detection + CSRT/KCF trackers; very flexible but requires coding

Name: OpenPTV / PyPTV
Notes: 3D reconstruction from multi-camera; 2D also possible per-camera

Name: ParticleTracker 2D and 3D
Notes: An ImageJ Plugin for multiple particle detection and tracking from digital videos. Based on Sbalzarini & Koumoutsakos 2005. Part of the MOSAIC toolbox

Name: PlanktoScope
Notes: Associated with PlanktoScope hardware; flow-through imaging; classification-focused

Name: SAM 2
Notes: Segment Anything Model 2; video segmentation + tracking; zero-shot; very promising for plankton

Name: SAM 3
Notes: SAM 3 adds text/exemplar prompts and tracks all instances at once; SAM 3.1 adds faster multi-object tracking

Name: SLEAP
Notes: Multi-animal pose tracking; GUI for labeling + training; DLC alternative

Name: Tracker
Notes: Java; manual + auto-tracking; calibration; widely used in biomechanics and teaching

Name: TrackMate
Notes: Fiji plugin; LoG/DoG/HessianDet + LAP/KF/simple; scripting API; widely cited

Name: Trackpy
Notes: Pandas-based; Crocker-Grier linking; fast; Pythonic; good for batch

Name: YOLO + ByteTrack
Notes: Detection + tracking pipeline; needs training data; fast inference
